div.div: 4 ابكاهُ [He made him, or caused him, to weep; or] he did to him what made him to weep; (S, K;) as also ↓ استبكاهُ . (S.) And عَلَيْهِ ↓ بكّاهُ , inf. n. تَبْكِيَةٌ, He excited him to weep for him, or it; (K, TA;) namely, a person dead, (K,) or a thing lost. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
